reason: Release PRs (GITHUB_TOKEN-authored) never trigger pull_request workflows, so the 9 required ruleset contexts sit Expected forever and every release PR is unmergeable without a human close/reopen. Fix: release-please dispatches release-pr-gate.yml (workflow_dispatch is exempt from token trigger suppression) whose jobs carry the required-context names and each verifies the diff is strictly version/changelog files, then arms native auto-merge. Workflows ship as operator patches (constitution-guarded).
